name: Elissa founds Carthage
summary: A princess of Tyre flees her brother, King Pygmalion, with a band of nobles. They stop in Cyprus and sail on to Africa, where she buys as much land as an oxhide will cover, cuts it into strips and founds Qart-hadasht, the New City. The story is legend; the date fits the archaeology.

stops.note: Elissa's husband is murdered by her brother; she gathers his treasure and her followers.
In Cyprus the priest of Astarte joins them, with eighty young women.
The oxhide is cut into one long strip around the hill of Byrsa. Qart-hadasht, the New City.
